title: How Machines Learn
description: AI/Machine Learning explainer video for beginners. Professional blue/cyan theme, calm narrator, ambient music, YouTube 16:9 landscape. Fully curated local asset path.
script:
Every day, artificial intelligence shapes your world — from the videos you watch to the way you work. [Visual: ml_brain_circuit.mp4] [Transition: fade] [Grade: cool] [CaptionTheme: minimal]
Machine learning is a type of AI where computers learn from data, not from explicit programming. They find patterns on their own. [Visual: ml_data_streams.mp4] [Transition: slide] [Grade: cool] [Kinetic: on]
Think of it like teaching a child. You show thousands of examples — photos of cats and dogs — until the computer learns to tell them apart by itself. [Visual: ml_cat_dog.mp4] [Transition: slide] [Grade: neutral]
You use ML every day. Netflix recommendations, YouTube suggestions, voice assistants — all powered by algorithms that learn from your behavior. [Visual: local_s0.mp4] [Transition: fade] [Grade: cool] [Kinetic: on]
There are three main types: supervised learning uses labeled data, unsupervised finds hidden patterns, and reinforcement learns through trial and error. [Visual: ml_three_types.mp4] [Transition: zoomblur] [Grade: vivid] [CaptionTheme: bold]
AI is transforming healthcare, education, and business — projected to reach over one point eight trillion dollars by 2030. [Visual: ml_futuristic_city.mp4] [Transition: fade] [Grade: cinematic] [KenBurns: on]
Machine learning is shaping tomorrow, today. Like and subscribe for more technology explained simply. [Visual: ml_subscribe.mp4] [Transition: fade] [Grade: cool] [CaptionTheme: bold]

outro.ctaText: Subscribe for more tech explained simply
